claim_text: Limited sun exposure may reduce cutaneous vitamin D synthesis but cannot by itself establish vitamin D deficiency or determine a supplement dose; dietary intake, life stage, season, geography and clinical factors also matter.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe assessment of nutrient intake and avoid inappropriate or duplicate supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting limited sun exposure; consider diet, age, season and current supplements.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food, fortified foods and/or relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin D Health Professional Fact Sheet describes sources, status assessment and risk factors.
limitations: Sun exposure questionnaire alone is insufficient; no individualized dose from this claim.
Source claim and cited underlying studies require full-text appraisal before approval.
